en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of two substantial brick civic buildings separated by trees and hedges. On the right is a large, ornate, three‑story Victorian public building with tall arched windows, a central tower with a flagpole, decorative roof balustrade, and broad stairways leading to an elevated entrance, likely a courthouse or city hall. On the left stands a smaller, one‑story rectangular building with a hipped roof and evenly spaced arched windows, possibly a library or annex. The foreground shows a neatly landscaped street corner with sidewalks, hedges, and a fire hydrant. The sky area appears overexposed or retouched. No clear printed caption is visible.
